title: AVAX activity briefing
command: Produce an evidence-backed AVAX briefing for the past seven days: market activity, network observations, and ecosystem releases. Separate observations, estimates, and missing data.
description: Three research leads each delegate to two researchers. Research covers Avalanche activity; inference payments use native USDC on Avalanche C-Chain.

specialists.title: Market activity lead
specialists.goal: Explain the supplied price and volume observations without extrapolating venue data to the whole market.

researchers.title: Price researcher
researchers.question: Summarize the daily AVAX-USD candles over the supplied window. State the venue and incomplete-day limitations.

researchers.title: Volume researcher
researchers.question: Compare available daily and 24-hour volume; distinguish AVAX volume from USD values.

specialists.title: Network observation lead
specialists.goal: Explain what the observed metrics establish and what they cannot establish.

researchers.title: Capital researcher
researchers.question: Describe the seven-day TVL observations; TVL is not transaction throughput.

researchers.title: Chain researcher
researchers.question: Describe the observed mainnet block, timestamp, transaction count, and gas use. A single block does not prove weekly activity.

specialists.title: Ecosystem release lead
specialists.goal: Summarize official releases inside the requested window.

researchers.title: Node release researcher
researchers.question: Summarize the dated AvalancheGo release notes. Report an empty window honestly.

researchers.title: EVM release researcher
researchers.question: Summarize the dated Subnet-EVM release notes and source links.
